# `swap` check

Check swap usage on this machine (passes when no swap is configured).

```yaml
checks:
  example:
    type: swap
    expect:
      used: { warn: 50%, fail: 80% }
```

## Keys

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expect` | mapping |  | What counts as healthy. |
| `expect.used` | {warn, fail} percent | `{warn: 50%, fail: 80%}` | Share of swap in use. Triggers when the value is above the threshold. |

Every check also accepts the [common keys](../config.md#common-check-keys).

One-liner: `medic check swap [--set key=value ...]`
